title: PlanRevisedData
description: data of plan.revised (ADR-0028). The planner compiled a confirmed change (the meeting.change_requested with this proposal_id, which is this event's cause) into revision units, and the plan validator accepted the revised plan (PG-13). actor is the world's Director, target the world. run is same_run when the discussed run was still live (the units join it) and revision_run when it had finished: then this event is the first of a new run of the same world (new run_id), and budget.requested, budget.granted and world.started follow (MR-09, MR-10). credits is the revision's estimate. Not a side effect: the units' own side effects wait at gates or policies like any unit's.

revision_unit.description: A new plan unit and the unit whose work it changes (plan.schema.json unit revises).
